new_result_summary: For the partner's exact-rank-three Schur-isotropic residual Parseval branch, MSS q=2 plus exact determinant accounting gives Z >= |detD|^2(c_delta a_delta)^3(1+2r^2), where a_delta=1/2+sqrt(2delta)+delta and c_delta=1-a_delta. The D/D' row gate extends the branch to delta<(39-6sqrt30)/98. The density is bounded by 6sqrt(e)F_delta(c_delta a_delta)^(-1/2)s^(-1)[(1+r^2)^2/(1+2r^2)]^(1/6). At delta=1/18 this is 27sqrt(e/2)s^(-1)[(1+r^2)^2/(1+2r^2)]^(1/6), at most 0.353553 times the partner r26 certificate. D/D' Fourier decay also gives a continuous C0 density on this branch.
primary_source_transfer: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov implies ||p_LX||inf<=2^(k/2)/sqrt(det(LL^T)) for any full-row-rank linear map L of a cap-one product source; applied here, ||p_(Y+rnX0)||inf<=2sqrt2/sqrt(1+r^2). This is not combined with the refuted arbitrary-joint coarea inequality.
